data.name: Finstad
data.long_meaning: Finstad is a Scandinavian name derived from the Old Norse words 'fin' meaning 'fine, fair' and 'staðr' meaning 'place, stead'. The name Finstad translates to 'Vale of the steadfast'. It symbolizes a person who remains steadfast in their beliefs or actions, especially in difficult times.
